tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i cho ga bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bsgrub mchod kyi rim pa ni/ rdo rje glu gar gyi rgyud las// gnas khang byi dor chag chag gdab// dkyil 'khor stegs bu legs byugs nas// rten bkram bla re mchod pa bsham// mi yi lpags pa'i g.yang gzhi ni// dbus su bla ma'i gdan du 'bul// shar dang mer ni khyi yi ste// lho dang bden bral rta lpags so// nub dang rlung du glang po che// byang dang dbang ldan ba glang gi /lpags pa'i gdan rnams bsham par bya// yang na rigs mthun dam tshig gi /sha dang mthun pa'i lpags pa bting*// gser las byas pa'i maṇ+ḍal bsham// rol mo'i tshogs kyang nye bar bzhag /khrus ma byas par gsol mi gdab// gsol ba ma btab sgo mi dbye// brda' ma sprad par nang mi gzhug /skyor chu ma blud gtam mi smra// maṇ+ḍal ma phul phyag mi 'tshal// phyag ma phul bar gral mi bya// rdo rjes bskul la mnyam par bzhag /bzlas brjod mchod bstod rim rdzogs na// thig le ma bkod mchod mi bya// dam tshig ma brims tshogs mi za// bza' rgyu ji snyed bzang ngan las// dag dang ma dag mi lta zhing*// gos pa med par longs spyad do// de nas lhag ma kun bsdus te// chang gi kha phru dang ldan pas// gtor ma'i tshogs rnams byin nas ni// yang ni glu gar rol mo'i tshogs// mchod pa kun gyis yang dag mchod// smon lam btab la bkra shis brjod// ye shes gshegs la dam tshigs bsdus/ zhes gsungs pa ni spyi don te/ legs par bshams nas/ 'dus pa rnams phyi rol du khrus byas te/ sgo bsrungs dbyug sngon du byas pa la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khro bo sngon po mdzes pa ste// khyod ni dam tshig yid du 'ong*// nor bu rin chen spyir bcings pa'i// dbyug pa phyag na bsnams pa'o// bdag ni 'khor ba las sgral phyir// dpa' bos gnang gis btang du gsol// rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs dbus su// bzang pos sgo 'di phye ste thong*// khyod ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bdag la gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs// zhes lan gsum brjod la nang du btang ste/

bdud rtsi'i chu blud nas phyag byas te gral la 'khod do/ de nas las kyi rdo rjes maṇ+ḍal phul la bskul ba ni// rdo rje 'dzin sogs dgongs su gsol// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes byas dang*// yon bdag bsod nams bskyed bya'i phyir// gnyis med ting 'dzin sa la bzhugs// sa ma t-i kra ma ho/ zhes brjod nas/ thams cad kyis bsrung 'khor mngon rtogs rgyas par bsgom ste/ spros pa la dga' na ye shes dgug pa'i skabs su// dmigs med thugs rjes mkha' ltar khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab rang rang skur ston pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// khyab bdag dpal ldan dus kyis 'khor lo ni// rgyal ba yab yum sems dpa' sems ma dang*// lha dang lha mo 'jig rten skyong la sogs// 'gro ba'i don du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ha ha hi hi badz+ra bhi ra bā ya/ a kar sha ya a kar sha ya/ pra pe sh+ya/ pra sh+ye bya/ bhan dha yā bhan dha yā/ to sh+ya to sh+ya/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho/ badz+ra ḍa ki ni hri ta ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phre ྃphre ྃphaṭa/ zhes spyan drang ngo*// bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ zhes dbyer med par byas la/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chu bzhi phul te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ tri dha du ke sha da/ kā lā tsakra argam̐ pra ti ts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du pa t+yam̐ pra ti tsa zhes zhabs bsil dang*/ ats+tsha ma nam̐ zhes zhal bsil dang*/ pro k+ṣa nam̐ zhes 'thor 'thung phul la/ de nas rgyud gzhan nas byung ba'i phyi nang gi mchod pa rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/

rig ma bcu drug dang*/ rdo rje rnam dpa' drug la sogs pa'ang skabs dang sbyar te des phul la/ thun mong ma yin pa lha mo bcu gnyis ni/ hūm̐ chos nyid rnam dag ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje'i dri chab ma// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod pa'i phyir// dri chab mas dri'i mchod pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ts+tsha badz+ra ghan dhe ghan dha ats+tsha nam̐ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ gzhan kyang 'gre'o/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje phreng ba ma/ rgyal ba phreng ba mas me tog gi mchod pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ ts+tsha badz+ra ma le ma la ar/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje bdug spos ma/ rgyal ba bdug spos mas oṃ ṭath+ya badz+ra du pe du ba ar/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje mar me ma/ rgyal ba mar me mas mar me'i oṃ ྚthu badz+ra dhi be dhi bam̐ ar tsa nam/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje zhal zas ma/ rgyal ba zhal zas mas bdud rtsi'i oṃ sa chu badz+ra a mri ti ne pe te pu/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje zad med ma/ rgyal ba zas med mas bzang po'i mchod oṃ s+phu badz+ra ak+ṣa ta ak+ṣa te pu/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje sgeg pa mo/ rgyal ba sgeg pa mos mdzes pa'i oṃ r+thu badz+ra las+ye s+t+ra a bha ra nam̐ pu/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje bzhad pa mo/ rgyal ba bzhad mas dgyes pa'i/ oṃ r+tha badz+ra he s+ya ghan dha a dar sha pu tsam/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje gar bsgyur ma/ rgyab ba rgya gar mas gar gyis oṃ k+kha badz+ra nri te nri d+ya pu tsam/ hūm̐ chos nyid/ thugs rje'i mnga' bdag glu len ma/ rgyal ba glu mas glu'i oṃ s+sa badz+ra ghi ti ghi ta pu/ hūm̐ chos nyid thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'dod pa mo// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mchod pa'i phyir/

'dod mas bde ba'i mchod pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ s+sā badz+ra sarba bhud dha bo te sa ta naṃ/ pu tsa ku ru ku ru swa hā/ zhes dpag tu med pa spros la mchod do de nas na ma'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ ghu ru bhud dha bho te sa ta bh+yo na māḥ oṃ bhu dha yā na māḥ oṃ dharma yā na māḥ oṃ sang gha ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra swa ta ma na māḥ oṃ pradz+wa pa ra mi ta ye na māḥ oṃ pa bha bi ka ya yā na māḥ oṃ dharma ka ya na māḥ oṃ sam̐ bho ga kā ya yā na māḥ oṃ ni rma ka ya yā na māḥ oṃ dzña na badz+ra yā na māḥ oṃ tsī ta badz+ra yā na māḥ oṃ bāg badz+ra yā na māḥ oṃ ka yā badz+ra yā na māḥ oṃ tsa tur bhi mo k+ṣa bh+yo na māḥ oṃ tsa tur bh+ra ma bhi ha re bh+yo na māḥ oṃ sarba ta tring shad bho te pa k+ṣi ka dha rma bh+yo na māḥ oṃ tsa tu ra shi ti pa ta shre dharma kan dhe bh+yo na māḥ oṃ sarba dharma dha sha ke bh+yo na māḥ oṃ na mo rad na tra ya yā na māḥ oṃ shākya mu ne yā na māḥ oṃ ka la tsakra yā na māḥ oṃ dha na ra yā mi ta yā na māḥ oṃ shi la pa ta ya na māḥ oṃ k+ṣan ti pa ra mi ta yā na māḥ oṃ bhi t+yad pa ra mi ta yā na māḥ oṃ sa ma ti pa ra mi ta yā na māḥ oṃ pradzña pa ra mi ta yā+e nā māḥ oṃ u pa ya pa ra mi ta yā na māḥ oṃ pra ni dha pa ra mi ta yā na māḥ oṃ bha la pa ra mi ta yā na māḥ oṃ dzña na pa ra mi ta yā na māḥ oṃ dza ya gha te bh+ya na māḥ oṃ bhi dz+ra ya gha te bh+yo na māḥ oṃ sarba tsa h+na bh+yo na māḥ oṃ sarba mu tra bh+yo na māḥ oṃ tsi ta ma ṇi yā na māḥ oṃ dharma gha dhe yā na māḥ oṃ dharma sham ga ya na māḥ oṃ kal pa bhig k+ṣa yā na māḥ oṃ a k+ṣo bh+ya na māḥ oṃ a mo ka pi ta yā na māḥ oṃ rad na swa bha ba yā na māḥ oṃ rad na swa bha ba yā na māḥ oṃ i mi dā ba ya na māḥ oṃ bhai ro tsa na yā na māḥ oṃ lo tsa na yā+e na māḥ/ oṃ ma ma ki yā+e na maḥ oṃ pan dha ro ya na māḥ

oṃ ta ra ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra dha ru sha ri ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ba ni ye na māḥ oṃ kha gar ba yā+e na māḥ oṃ k+ṣi ti gar bā yā na māḥ oṃ lo ki shwa ra ya na māḥ oṃ sarba ni bha ra bhi kam̐ bhi ni ya na māḥ oṃ sa man bha tra ya na māḥ oṃ ghan dha badz+ri ye na māḥ oṃ ru pa badz+ra ye na māḥ oṃ ra sa badz+ra yā+e na māḥ oṃ par sha badz+ri ye na māḥ oṃ sha pa ta badz+ri ye na māḥ oṃ dharma ta tu badz+ri ye na māḥ oṃ u ṇi sha ye na māḥ oṃ bhi ga nan ta ka ya na māḥ oṃ prad dzñan dha ka ya na māḥ oṃ pad ma ka yā na māḥ oṃ ya man ka yā na māḥ oṃ stoṃ bhi ni ye na māḥ oṃ mo ha ni ye na māḥ oṃ stoṃ bhi ni ye na māḥ oṃ a ti bha r+ya ye na māḥ oṃ ā ti ni ye na māḥ oṃ sarba dha ra bh+yo na māḥ oṃ shan dha gha ya na māḥ zhes thugs kyi 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra tsar tsi ka ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hi she re ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra in tra ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bha ma ka ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā lak+ṣe me ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ko'u ma ti ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bhi snu bhe ye na māḥ oṃ a ྴྟ sha ṭa ke na tsa tur sha ṣ+ṭa dhi bh+yo na māḥ oṃ badz+ra yo ki ni ྴྟི sha ti i tsa bh+yo na māḥ zhes gsung gi dkyil 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra bhi snu shi na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ni ti t+ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ag nā+e na māḥ oṃ badz+ra dha na yo na māḥ oṃ badz+ra in tra ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra i sha ra ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bh+ra ma ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bhi na ya ka yā na māḥ oṃ badz+ra kar ti ka yā na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bha ya bhe na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ya ma ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa bh+ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra gha ru trā+ai na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bha ya bhai na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ya mi nai na māḥ oṃ badz+ra sak+ṣe nai na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā sa ma ma na māḥ oṃ badz+ra a tsa la man na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ra tsa ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ni la dhan dha yā na māḥ oṃ badz+ra sum bha ra tsa ya na māḥ

oṃ badz+ra ri da tra khyim na māḥ oṃ badz+ra shring kha la ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra tsun dha yā+e na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bhi ku tai na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ma ri tsa ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra pra ti ka la sabhe te na māḥ shu dha ra tri sa ta badz+raḥ oṃ badz+ra ti thi dhe bho bh+yo na māḥ oṃ badz+ra sha ta tri da shad badz+ra pra ta tshā bh+yo na māḥ oṃ badz+ra dza yā ra na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bha dza ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra pad ma yā na māḥ oṃ badz+ra kar ko tra ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bā su ka ya na maḥ oṃ badz+ra shaṃ ka pa la ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ta khya ka ya na mā/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā pad ma ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra a nan ta ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ku li ka ya na māḥ zhes sku'i dkyil 'khor la'o/ oṃ sh+ya na s+yai na māḥ oṃ ka khā s+yai na māḥ oṃ shu ga ra s+yai na māḥ oṃ shri ta s+yai na māḥ oṃ dzam̐ pu ka s+yai na māḥ oṃ gha ru s+yai na maḥ oṃ bh+ya gra s+yai na māḥ oṃ hū lu ka s+yai na māḥ oṃ sarba bhu de bh+yo na māḥ oṃ badz+ra tsan ṭa yā+e na māḥ oṃ badz+ra sur ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra mam̐ gha la ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bhur dha ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra sha ྄ta pa ti na māḥ oṃ badz+ra shu tra ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ka la ag ne yā na māḥ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe ye na māḥ oṃ badz+ra gha ha yā na māḥ oṃ badz+ra sarba na k+ṣe te bh+yo na māḥ oṃ badz+ra tra pe ri bh+yo na māḥ oṃ badz+ra sha ra sha ka lo bh+yo na māḥ oṃ badz+ra dha sa ti ka lo ka pa la dzho na māḥ oṃ badz+ra nan ti ki shwa ra ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ka la na māḥ oṃ badz+ra ghan dha ka ri ka ya na māḥ oṃ badz+ra bh+ri gh+ri ri na māḥ oṃ sarba k+ṣe tra pa la bh+yo na māḥ oṃ sarba bhu ti bh+yo na māḥ oṃ ha ri ṇa ye bh+yo na maḥ oṃ sarba si dhi bh+yo na māḥ oṃ dharma tsakra ya na māḥ oṃ bhad tra gha ra yāḥ oṃ dhu ru dhu ru bā+ai bh+yo na māḥ oṃ bho ti bhig k+ṣa ya na māḥ zhes na ma'i mchod pa'o/ bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud// yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud// stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// med pa las byung khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud// ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud// sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la 'dud// sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud// thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud//

thams cad 'byung ba khyod la 'dud// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// ces bstod do// gzhan yang bstod pa ci rigs pa byas nas bzlas pa cung zad byas te/ de nas tshogs sbyangs te mchod pa ni/ pad ma'i snod la gnas pa'i bdud rtsi la/ oṃ a hūm̐ hos sbyangs nas/ lag pa'i mthil du srin lag g.yas pa gru gsum byas pa'i dkyil du zlum po byas la/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar spyan drangs te/ sngags dang bcas pas mchod la mnyes par bya'o// yang de nyid kyi tshogs dang gtor ma la gsang gtor bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra kro te shwa ri sarba trab bya ni bhi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ las kyi rdo rjes/ hūm̐ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon nyid// gnyis med ye shes mthu ldan pas// dbyings las ma g.yos rtog med kyang*// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don slad du// rtse cig ldan pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// rdo rje can gyi skur sprul nas/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 'di// bdag gzhan lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes bskul nas thams cad kyi lag pa g.yon oṃ las zla ba/ g.yas a las nyi ma/ bar du hūm̐ las sgra gcan gyi ngo bo rlung byung nas/ mkha' lding phyag rgyas ho zhes dus mes sbyangs la/ rol mo dang bcas pas thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyis mchod pa 'di/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi lha tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo zhes brjod do/ tshogs rgyas pa lce spyang gi rgyud na yod kyang ma bris so// de nas phud gtor mar brtsal gtor ma btang bar bya'o// de nas las kyi rdo rjes rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya bcas te pad bskor dang bcas nas/ kye kye/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum// rang bzhin cig par dgongs su rol// 'di ni dngos grub chen po'i rgyud// zhes brjod do// de nas bla mas/

bde bar gshegs par chos kyi sku// 'dod chags dri ma dang bral ba// rin thang med pa legs 'ongs chos// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// de kho na nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// 'di ni dngos grub dam pa'i mchog /ma ha a ho su ga zhes blang ngo*// de nas tshogs la rol nas/ ting nge 'dzin brtan par bya'o// rtsod dang nga rgyal med pa dang*// ting 'dzin bde stong rol pa las// glu gar sna tshogs spyod pa rnams// lha yi nga rgyal ldan pas bya// de nas lhag ma thams cad bsdus te/ sngar zas kyi phud la chang bu/ oṃ ha ri ti bhin dhi ki pra ti ts+tsha swa hā/ oṃ du ti ke akra gra sam pra ti ts+tsha swā hā/ zhes brjod de sa la bzhag pa de dang bcas pa kha phrus bran te/ oṃ kha khā kha hi kha hi u tsa tri bā ling*/ u tsi da bha k+ṣa swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad la 'bul lo// tshim zhing zhi ba dang dgyes pa dang bde legs su gyur cig zhes sbyin no// de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ e ma rdo rje 'chang chen po// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dgongs su gsol// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la/ phung po lnga yi mchod pa yi// phung po lnga rnams gnas gyur nas// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku thob shog /ḍā ki rigs lnga yid 'ong ma// 'byung ba lnga yis mchod pa yis// 'byung chen kha ri gnas gyur nas// ye shes mkha' 'gro sku thob shog /dpa' bo dpa' mo 'dus pa la// 'dod yon drug gis mchod pa yis// yul dang dbang po gnas gyur nas// sems dpa' sems ma'i sku thob shog /las mkhan sprul pa'i lce spyang la// sha khrag sman gyis mchod pa yis// nyon mongs dug lnga gnas gyur nas// ye shes lnga yi sku thob shog /zhes brjod la/ bkra shis bya ba ni/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// dus kyi 'khor lo 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// sna tshogs yum bcas lha mo bcu dang rol pa yi// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig ye shes snying po la gnas pa// rdo rje sems sogs rgyal ba ye shes lnga yis dngos// yul lnga dbyer med lhan cig skyes par ro mnyam pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa// sems dpa' sems ma khro bo'i dbang po la sogs pa// dag pa'i bum pa mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa// bkra shis des kyang*// bkra shis gang zhig gsung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa// tsar tsi ka la sogs pa'i ma mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni// dag pa'i rlung du bde chen dbu mar brtan gyur pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sku yi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa// sum brgya drug cu phyi nang gzhan gsum rnam par dag /khro bo klu dang gtum mo nying lag yongs rdzogs pa// bden pa des kyang bden chen la gnas bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod 'khor yug la gnas pa// dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa la// bye ba phyed bzhi'i 'byung po kun gyi legs bsrungs pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde chen la gnas bkra shis shog /zhes bkra shis brjod do/ de nas mngon rtogs ltar lus rdo rjer gnas pa la lha rnams bsdu zhing gshegs su gsol nas// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// tshangs sogs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams// khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad// gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la// 'gal zhing 'khrul par gang gyur pa// ma tshang ba dang lhag pa rnams// kun tu bzod par mdzad nas kyang*// rang rang gnas su gshegs su gsol/ slar yang sems can don slad du// de nyid du ni byon par mdzod// zhes brjod la/ bsngo bas rgyas gdab po// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ tshogs kyi rim pa 'grel pa chen po dang*/ lce spyang tshogs rol dang*/ dus 'khor zhabs kyis mdzad pa rnams tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa dang*/

bla ma'i gsung sgros phyag len rnams/ rang byung rdo rjes gus pa'i yid kyis bsdus pa lags/ bsod nams rgya chen nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'byung zhing*/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig /mkhas pa'i nga rgyal dor zhing bla ma'i gsung bzhin bya// rgyud don 'grel pa rtogs shing mngon sum mig dang ldan// phyi nang gzhan gsum bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis rdzogs// de phyir khengs pa dor la tshul der zhugs na legs// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / ༈ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas btus pa'i spos sbyor bzhugs so// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog mchod phyir spos sbyor bshad// rtsa ba nyi shu rtsa lnga la// bye brag dbye ba 'di ltar sbyar// re'u mig 'phred ma lnga po 'di// dang po bsil sbyor rab lnga yin// gnyis pa lnga pa drod dang ldan// de 'og bsil drod sdebs ma 'bring*// 'bring 'og dri ma cung zad dug /tha ma lnga ni dri ma dngas// yang ni gyen thur lnga yod de// ga phur can lnga shin tu bsil// si la can lnga dri ma bzang*// tsan dan can lnga bsil drod snyoms// byug spos lnga po drod dang ldan// tha ma lnga ni sngo sbyor lags// zur sdebs lnga tshan gnyis yod pa// ga bur can de kha ba'i spos// gla rtsi can de gdon la bdug /gu gul gnod par shes bya'o// de ltar spos sbyor bcu gnyis so// mtha' nas bskor ba'i dgu sbyor bzhi// kun kyang dri mchog ldan pa yin// de bzhin bdun sbyor bzhi yod pa// 'bring po'i spos su bstan pa yin// de bzhin bzhi sbyor bzhi yod de// tha ma'i sbyor bar bstan pa'o// dkar ser bcu gsum sbyor sde gnyis// cung zad dri 'dres byug par bzang*// yang ni ser po gsum sbyor drug /dkar po gsum sbyor bzhi yod pa// bsil drod snyoms la dri yang bzang*// dkar po'i gnyis sbyor drug yod dang*// ser po gnyis sbyor bzhi yod pa// ma 'dzom gyur na sbyar rgyu yin// bco lnga sbyor sde bzhi yod pa// gang ltar sbyar yang dri mchog 'byung*// cha rnams grangs yig lta bu bya// de ltar sbyor sde lnga bcu cig

/zhib tu byas na brgya yod de// spos reng byed na kun gyi gzhi// shing dang sbrang dang bu ram yin// byug pa sbrang rtsi chu la sbyar// mar khu sku byug spos yin te// rlung mkhris bad kan so so ru// drod dang bsil dang snyoms par sbyar// kha dog 'dod na 'gri hang dang*// yung ba dang sbyar gser gyi mdog /tsha la yung ba rgya skag sbyar// shin du dmar bar 'gyur ba yin// de sogs rig pa'i mda' yis bsnun// sen skogs dang ni dri gtso ba// me tog dri sgo'i bye brag rnams// kho bos 'dir ni ma bshad do// spos sbyor zab cing sbyar sla ba// rang byung rdo rjes sbyar ba yin/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /
